description: The four steps in the normative order closure, hiding, mutex, warnings (AGSC-07-04 to 07-08): the requires closure adds mcp with an explanation path; supersedes hides the directly selected mcp-v1; excludes is then evaluated over the survivors and invalidates the composition; the absent uses target is only a warning. Evaluating excludes before hiding, evaluating it before the closure, or re-running the closure after hiding, gives a different answer — that is why the order is normative. selection[] is the surviving set in code-point order, so the input order a2a, mcp-v1, legacy-rpc does not reach the verdict.
